# LoadedBundle

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class LoadedBundle : IDisposable
```

An upload bundle opened for looking at: a marketplace export that left `set.json` out. Read only; owns the temporary folder when it came from a packed `.set`.
